claims.claim: Reviewers state that the early game is extremely difficult and punishing for beginners trying to get started.

citations.review_text:
For a free Minecraft clone with a predefined, finite world, one cannot really complain. The gameplay is alright, has a bit of complexity and there is some progression and final goal. 

For a solo player, there is not too much to do. It is probably more fun in a multiplayer server with friends. 

The first few days are unforgiving, but I have no major complaints about the game. There were no technical issues. The game is lightweight, runs smoothly and does not stutter or freeze.
How are you even supposed to start out in this game? It seems difficult for the sake of difficulty, in the extreme early game.

The other reviews weren't kidding. This game is harder than every game made by Bossa Studios combined. And it's a survival game. I personally didn't like the difficulty spike, but I know some people will

As a beginner, this was not an enjoyable experience, even on easy mode. Probably got outpaced/outscaled within 7 days;  little time to explore and get a bearing. Friends fared way better and they kept on reviving me, but especially as the game progressed, pretty much would get killed in 1-2 hits and would need reviving again.

I would rather go to church than play this game.

Muck is an incredibly addictive, fast-paced free-to-play roguelike survival game that turns a colorful island excursion into a chaotic battle for your life. Dropping into a vibrant, procedurally generated world with absolutely nothing, the game hooks you immediately with a frantic loop of gathering resources, crafting legendary weapons, and hunting for powerful item chests before night falls. Once darkness hits, the calm environment transforms into an intense test of skill as massive bosses and relentless enemy hordes assault your base, pushing your movement and combat mechanics to their limits. With its surprisingly smooth mechanics, hilarious physics, and an absolute blast of a multiplayer mode that turns the grueling difficulty into pure cooperative fun, it delivers an elite rogue-lite experience that rivals many premium survival titles.

Absolute peak of a game. So much fun and free???? Do yourself a favor an try it out. Maybe even bring a friend or two for even more mucky fun.
    My only gripe is poor graphics optimization. With how this game looks, I should be able to run max settings with an RX 7700S but if I do I end up pegging the GPU and stuttering in weird scenarios.
    All in all an amazing title, and if you want to have an OP seed, try out 221294511, go to the cave by spawn for best weapon in game straight off the bat. What are you waiting for? GET MUCKING!

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as difficult, noting that it can feel unbalanced or overwhelming for new or solo players.

citations.review_text:
This game is cool, and I like the concept of it and I do know that it used to be easier. But I have some problems with it. For example, if your going in blind to the game, you are going to have a hard time playing the game because if you don't really have people to play with, the game is just increasingly hard for no reason. I understand that games can be hard to play but for me I would not recommend this game for a single player experience. If you have friends, then you could definitely play this game. The randomness and how fast you have to be in order to survive is just overwhelming. 

Overall, the game is really dependent on the players experience and exposure to the game. If the player is not familiar with it they will struggle deeply. And some things also just feel unfair.

This game is an amazing concept but in reality its wayyy too unbalanced. You have to be really good to play this but even if you are youre gonna die alot. I liked the game at first but its just an unfinished and unbalanced mess.
pretty good, but it is quite difficult.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the achievement system as extremely difficult and rough to complete.

citations.review_text:
For a game that was made out of spite, this is a solid addition to survival-roguelikes. The graphics are pretty simple but that has its own charm. Abilities vary but it's not too hard to get some rarer stuff early on. The game is meant to be harsh with you, not expecting you to try surviving there for long, it is MUCH better to try escaping and defeating the dragon rather than end up fighting like 20 bosses at the same time because you stayed for 10 days there. The achievements are also ROUGH but even thought I love completing my games, I simply cannot be mad over it- I've had my fair share of fun. Some seeds give an advantage of gaining a weapon early-game so if you're as desperate as me, you can try using those. 

I had the time when I had a fixation for Muck so I do believe that it has replayability potential, playing with friends IS fun but pick those that don't ragequit after losing because you will be dying and failing a LOT. don't even try building a home UNLESS you have a proven strategy (like building something high up in the sky, tried doing that- works well if you do it fast but then going down is like entering rings of hell), otherwise you'll see what is the definition of building demolition.

Overall, fun game, solo and multiplayer and for free? yes please
Such a good survival game although dont do the 100day achivement it was pure hell for me i had to sit up until 6am and play muck for 10hrs straight but still a real banger of a game! Thanks Dani.
lot of fun, just dont achievement hunt
